# Touchline Sport Academy
> Dubai's Best Football Academy for Kids, Youth & Adults

Touchline Sport Academy (TSA) is the premier football academy in Dubai, UAE, offering professional, structured, and fun football training programs for boys and girls aged 3 to 18+. Led by qualified, experienced coaches, TSA is committed to developing the next generation of football talent in Dubai and across the UAE. TSA is a UAEFA approved academy with coaches holding CAF C, AFC B, and AFC A licences.

## About

Touchline Sport Academy was founded with a singular mission: to provide world-class football coaching in a safe, supportive, and high-performance environment. With two main training locations in Dubai — Al Nahda and Al Warqa — TSA has quickly established itself as the most trusted and highly rated football academy in the UAE.

Our approach is player-first: every coaching session is designed to develop technical skills, tactical awareness, physical fitness, and mental strength. We believe in structured progression, small group sizes, and high coach-to-player ratios to ensure every child receives personalized attention.

**Rating:** 4.9/5 stars based on 200+ verified Google reviews  
**Slogan:** Building Tomorrow's Champions Today

## Key Programs & Services

- **U6 Pre-Academy (Ages 3–5):** Fun-based introductory football for toddlers and young children. Focus on motor skills, coordination, and love for the game.
- **U8 Academy (Ages 6–7):** Foundational football skills, ball control, and small-sided games for young beginners.
- **U10 Academy (Ages 8–9):** Intermediate skill development, tactical introduction, and competitive mini-matches.
- **U12 Academy (Ages 10–11):** Advanced technical and tactical training, position-specific coaching, and tournament preparation.
- **U14+ Academy (Ages 12–18):** High-performance pathway training with professional-level coaching, analysis, and competitive fixtures.
- **Girls Football Program:** Currently forming — register your interest to join the waitlist.
- **Adult Football Training (Ages 16+):** Recreational and competitive options for adult players of all levels. Sessions run evenings and weekends.
- **Personal Coaching (1-on-1):** Individualized coaching sessions tailored to specific player goals. AED 350 per session.
- **Corporate Team Training:** Custom football programs for companies and organisations focused on team-building and fitness.
- **Goalkeeping Program:** Specialist goalkeeper training and development.

## Training Locations

### Al Nahda Branch (Main Location)
- Inside Al Ahli Club, Al Nahda 1, behind Al Mulla Plaza
- Near Stadium Metro Station, Dubai, UAE
- Google Maps: https://share.google/4aEGRCbVudLexST5h
- Easy metro access and ample parking

### Al Warqa Branch
- Inside International Academy, Al Warqa 1, Dubai, UAE
- Google Maps: https://share.google/kMzSFaorHm2YLRQLz

## Pricing (Season 2026/2027)

- **Per Session (drop-in):** AED 130 for 2 sessions/week
- **Registration Fee (one-time):** AED 250 — includes two sets of jersey and shorts
- **Term 1 (September – December):** AED 1,600 for 32 sessions
- **Term 2 (January – March):** AED 1,200 for 24 sessions
- **Term 3 (April – June):** AED 1,200 for 24 sessions
- **Full Year (September – June):** AED 4,000 for 80 sessions
- **Personal 1-to-1 Session:** AED 350 per session
- First session is a **free trial** — no payment required
